functions.name: send-transactional-message

headers.description: Additional message headers in order. Omit for no explicit header override; an empty array is sent as an explicit empty collection. Duplicate names remain separate entries, subject to messenger support.

name.description: Message header field name, such as X-Request-ID. Header ordering is retained.

value.description: Ordinary header value without CR or LF. Empty values are preserved; no pre-encoding is required.

items.description: One additional message header with an ordinary name and value.

fromEmail.description: Sender value for this message, in the sender syntax supported by the configured messenger. Omit to leave sender selection to the provider.

messenger.description: Name of the configured Listmonk messenger to use. Omit to let the provider choose its default; names are instance-specific.

templateId.description: Opaque positive decimal ID of the existing template to render for this message.

contentType.description: Content type requested for the rendered message, using a value supported by the selected messenger. Omit to use the provider's default; supported values require instance/provider validation.

subscriberId.description: Opaque positive decimal ID of the subscriber in this Listmonk instance. Supply this or subscriberEmail, never both.

templateData.description: Named template variables as JSON values, preserving nested objects, arrays, null, and empty values. Omit to use the provider's behavior without supplied variables.

additionalProperties.description: A JSON template variable value, including nested values and null.

subscriberEmail.description: Email address used to identify the subscriber. Supply this or subscriberId, never both; this is not a request to create a subscriber.

FunctionInput_listmonk_sendtransactional.description: Send one template-based transactional message using exactly one existing subscriber selector.

tags.instructions: Use this to send one transactional message, not to create or launch a campaign. Have an existing template ID and either the subscriber's ID or email address ready; provide exactly one subscriber selector. Supply template variables as ordinary structured data. Optional headers and sender settings affect this message. The result reports the provider's acceptance indicator, not delivery. Do not automatically repeat a send after an ambiguous result: a repeat may send a duplicate.
